pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with soft-focus edge gradients. Patch spatial area is maximal on the lateral flank, becoming smaller and more densely clustered toward the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of high-luminance pelage forming thick pathways between dark patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial with consistent pixel thickness across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency fringe along the upper neck and shoulder. The silhouette shows a continuous, short-haired mane against the blurred background.
